title: Tensor component of the canonical pullback compositor
statement:
theorem tensorComparison_composition_tensor {X Y Z : Site.{u, w}}
    (f : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} Z.A Y.A)
    (g : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} Y.A X.A)
    (h : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} Z.A X.A)
    (kf : CochainPullback.Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} f) (kg : CochainPullback.Comparison.{u, u, u,
      u, u} g) (kh : CochainPullback.Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} h)
    (a : CochainPullback.CompositePresentation.{u, u, u, u, u, u, u} f g h kf kg kh)
    (df : Pullback.{u, w} f) (dg : Pullback.{u, w} g) (dh : Pullback.{u, w} h)
    (c : dh.F ≅ df.F ⋙ dg.F)
    (hc : (∀ (P : CochainPullback.Complex.{u, u, u} Z.A), Resolving Z P →
        c.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ dg.F.map (df.epsilon.app P) ≫
            dg.epsilon.app ((CochainPullback.pull.{u, u, u, u, u} f).obj P) =
          dh.epsilon.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainPullback.composition.{u, u, u, u, u, u,
            u} f g h a P).hom)) :
      (∀ M N : Z.D,
        (tensorComparison h kh dh).hom.app (M, N) ≫
            X.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (c.hom.app M) (c.hom.app N)) =
          c.hom.app (Z.closed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
            dg.F.map ((tensorComparison f kf df).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
            (tensorComparison g kg dg).hom.app (df.F.obj M, df.F.obj N))

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0D6D and the balanced cochain comparison equations; split from the parent normalization theorem.

proof.text: Paste the two already proved tensor representative squares by naturality of the second tensor comparison and its counit. This proves the representative normalization for the composite pullback word. Resolving computation and preservation of flat-term K-flat complexes make both composite counits invertible. The generic pasting calculation is now comparison_tensor_descends in the extracted proof-support module. The native tensor-model naturality and cochain compositor tensor equation are called through the extracted proved API, avoiding repeated unfolding of their constructions.

On a resolving pair cancel the source model isomorphism and the tensor of the two invertible composite counits. Substitute the supplied normalization of c at P, Q and their tensor. Naturality of the target tensor model and the cochain composition equation identify the remaining two routes.

Regard the two sides as natural transformations of derived bifunctors. Fully faithful restriction to resolving pairs makes their equality follow from the preceding representative calculation. Evaluate the resulting equality at (M,N).
